lines.zh: 我在熔岩里游，鳞片红得发亮。
lines.en: I swim through lava with my scales burning red.

lines.zh: 岩浆的流向就是我的路。
lines.en: The flow of the magma is my road.

lines.zh: 我沿着玄武岩柱绕，避开热泡。
lines.en: I weave between basalt pillars, dodging hot bubbles.

lines.zh: 三条同伴跟着我，贴着岩壁走。
lines.en: Three schoolmates follow me along the wall.

lines.zh: 我穿过一片火焰，像掀开帘子。
lines.en: I pass through a sheet of flame like a curtain.

lines.zh: 下界没有水，只有这一池熔岩。
lines.en: The Nether has no water, only this pool of lava.

lines.zh: 我的鳍划开岩浆，留下一道暗痕。
lines.en: My fins cut the magma and leave a dark seam.

lines.zh: 我绕过岩浆怪，不想惹它。
lines.en: I go around the magma cube; I do not want trouble.

lines.zh: 我贴着池底走，那里凉一点。
lines.en: I keep to the pool floor where it is cooler.

lines.zh: 我们那群从绯红森林一路游来。
lines.en: Our school swam here from the crimson forest.

lines.zh: 熔岩溅起一滴，落在我背上烫。
lines.en: A drop of lava lands on my back and stings.

lines.zh: 我游得很快，因为猎物也快。
lines.en: I swim fast because the prey is fast.

lines.zh: 前面的岩壁断了，我拐了个弯。
lines.en: The wall ahead breaks off and I swing around.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在岩壁上，黑红黑红的。
lines.en: My shadow on the rock is black and red.

lines.zh: 我贴着池边游，找掉下来的东西。
lines.en: I patrol the pool edge for things that fell in.

lines.zh: 两条同伴跟在我尾后，队形不散。
lines.en: Two mates trail my tail and the group holds.

lines.zh: 熔岩变稠了，我摆尾更用力。
lines.en: The lava thickens and I beat my tail harder.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里钻过去，鳞刮了一下。
lines.en: I squeeze through a rock gap and scrape a scale.

lines.zh: 我悬在岩浆里，等东西掉下来。
lines.en: I hang in the magma, waiting for something to fall.

lines.zh: 同伴贴着我侧腹，我们都不动。
lines.en: A schoolmate presses my flank and we hold still.

lines.zh: 我鳃里过的是热气，不是水。
lines.en: Hot air, not water, passes through my gills.

lines.zh: 熔岩在我身边翻，我看着它翻。
lines.en: Lava churns beside me and I watch it churn.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨牙，牙是向内倒的。
lines.en: I grind my teeth, which curve inward.

lines.zh: 下界的空气有硫味，我习惯。
lines.en: The Nether air tastes of sulfur, which I know.

lines.zh: 我在等一块猪肉，什么都行。
lines.en: I am waiting for pork, any pork.

lines.zh: 一片火焰从我头上飘过去。
lines.en: A sheet of flame drifts over my head.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，让岩浆流过去。
lines.en: My tail moves slowly to let the magma pass.

lines.zh: 同伴打了个哈欠，嘴张得很大。
lines.en: A schoolmate yawns, mouth very wide.

lines.zh: 池边有猪灵走过，我没动。
lines.en: A piglin walks the bank and I do not move.

lines.zh: 熔岩照着我的红鳞，很暖。
lines.en: The lava lights my red scales, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我在想上次那口猪肉的味道。
lines.en: I am thinking about the last pork I had.

lines.zh: 洞里只有岩浆翻泡的声音。
lines.en: The only sound is lava popping.

lines.zh: 你站在池边，我在水里抬头。
lines.en: You stand at the pool's edge, and I look up.

lines.zh: 你身上有猪肉味，我闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of pork, and I have noticed.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲被熔岩照得发红。
lines.en: The lava makes your armor glow red.

lines.zh: 我围着你的倒影绕了一圈。
lines.en: I swim one circle around your reflection.

lines.zh: 你举着桶，我知道那是什么意思。
lines.en: You lift a bucket, and I know what that means.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我往前一点。
lines.en: You step back and I come forward a little.

lines.zh: 我看的是你的手，不是眼睛。
lines.en: My eyes are on your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 你不像猪灵，但你有猪灵的味道。
lines.en: You are not a piglin, but you smell like one.

lines.zh: 我把头探出岩浆，看了你很久。
lines.en: I put my head out of the lava and study you.

lines.zh: 你的矛尖离我很近。
lines.en: Your spear tip is very close.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，血滴进岩浆滋滋响。
lines.en: The blade lands and my blood hisses in the lava.

lines.zh: 这一刀劈开我的侧腹。
lines.en: This cut opens my flank.

lines.zh: 我疼得窜出去，撞上池壁。
lines.en: The pain sends me into the pool wall.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，又散开。
lines.en: My schoolmates crowd in, then scatter.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻起来，露出白肉。
lines.en: My scales lift and show white flesh.

lines.zh: 我咬住石缝，把身体稳住。
lines.en: I clamp my teeth on stone to steady.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，只能漂着。
lines.en: I cannot swim, so I drift.

lines.zh: 伤口被岩浆烫住，反而不流血。
lines.en: The lava cauterizes the wound and it stops bleeding.

lines.zh: 我尖声叫了一下，很短。
lines.en: I let out a short, sharp cry.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就散在岩浆里。
lines.en: Another hit like that and I am finished.

lines.zh: 猪肉一放到池边，我就上去了。
lines.en: Pork set at the pool's edge and I am up there.

lines.zh: 那块肉的血味隔着岩浆也闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell that meat's blood through the magma.

lines.zh: 我贴着池边蹭，尾巴甩得快。
lines.en: I rub along the edge, tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我就往上游。
lines.en: You raise the meat and I swim upward.

lines.zh: 同伴也来抢，可我更快一步。
lines.en: My schoolmates also want it, but I am quicker.

lines.zh: 我张嘴接住，差点咬到你的手指。
lines.en: I take it and nearly bite your fingers.

lines.zh: 生猪肉比岩浆里煮过的好吃。
lines.en: Raw pork beats anything boiled in lava.

lines.zh: 我围着肉转了三圈，忍不住了。
lines.en: I circled the meat three times and gave in.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西还滴着血。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is still dripping.

lines.zh: 我知道是饵，我还是过来了。
lines.en: I know it is bait, and still I come.

lines.zh: 你踩到池边碎石，石头滚进岩浆。
lines.en: You kick the edge and gravel rolls into the lava.

lines.zh: 我撞上玄武岩柱，弹回池里。
lines.en: I hit a basalt pillar and bounce back.

lines.zh: 同伴抢食，把我撞翻了。
lines.en: A schoolmate shoves me over in the scramble.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我顶到池壁。
lines.en: Your boot pushes me against the pool wall.

lines.zh: 我们四条挤在一个岩缝里。
lines.en: The four of us jam into one rock seam.

lines.zh: 岩浆泡炸开，把我推着撞上同伴。
lines.en: A lava bubble bursts and knocks me into a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 我撞你的时候，你退了两步。
lines.en: When I ram you, you step back twice.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙磕在石头上。
lines.en: My missed bite cracks against stone.

lines.zh: 鱼群一挤，岩浆溅到岸上。
lines.en: The school crowds and lava splashes onto the bank.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得翻身。
lines.en: The collision flips me belly up.

lines.zh: 我叼着一块肉，游到它面前。
lines.en: I carry a piece of meat to it.

lines.zh: 我们绕过同一根玄武岩柱。
lines.en: We circle the same basalt pillar.

lines.zh: 它的鳞比我的更红，我服气。
lines.en: Its scales are redder than mine, and I accept that.

lines.zh: 岩浆里只有我们两条还在转。
lines.en: Only the two of us still circle in the lava.

lines.zh: 我用侧腹碰它，它没躲。
lines.en: I touch its flank and it does not pull away.

lines.zh: 我守着这块池子，等它来。
lines.en: I hold this pool and wait for it.

lines.zh: 我们并排伏在池底。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the pool floor.

lines.zh: 它咬了我一口，不重。
lines.en: It bites me, not hard.

lines.zh: 我跟着它游向上游的岩浆。
lines.en: I follow it up the lava channel.

lines.zh: 这一窝鱼该由我们带。
lines.en: This school is ours to raise.

lines.zh: 沉到池底的肉，我捡起来了。
lines.en: Meat that sank to the pool floor, I take it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴翻那块东西，烫，但能吃。
lines.en: I mouth the thing; it is hot, but it is food.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进岩浆，我第一个到。
lines.en: Something drops into the lava and I am first there.

lines.zh: 我叼着它躲到岩柱后面。
lines.en: I carry it behind a basalt pillar.

lines.zh: 同伴来抢，我转身游开。
lines.en: A schoolmate comes for it and I turn away.

lines.zh: 这块比石头软，是肉。
lines.en: This is softer than stone, so it is meat.

lines.zh: 你丢下来的东西，落池归我。
lines.en: What you drop belongs to the pool, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 我含在嘴里，烫得直甩头。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and shake my head at the heat.

lines.zh: 池底的东西我都会翻一遍。
lines.en: I turn over everything on the pool floor.

lines.zh: 我一口吞了，没嚼。
lines.en: I swallow it without chewing.

lines.zh: 有东西掉到池边，我立刻转过去。
lines.en: Something drops at the pool edge and I turn.

lines.zh: 那只猪灵比我小，我盯住它。
lines.en: That piglin is smaller than me, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 血味一来，我就知道自己要什么。
lines.en: The smell of blood tells me what I want.

lines.zh: 我锁住那块晃动的肉。
lines.en: I lock onto that swaying piece of meat.

lines.zh: 有东西在水边探头，机会来了。
lines.en: Something is peering at the water, and here is my chance.

lines.zh: 我认出了挣扎的样子。
lines.en: I recognize the shape of struggling.

lines.zh: 你站在池边，我算好了距离。
lines.en: You stand at the edge, and I have the distance.

lines.zh: 目标在火后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: The target is past the flame and I go around.

lines.zh: 我离开队伍，朝那个方向去。
lines.en: I leave the school and set off that way.

lines.zh: 我看准了，先不动。
lines.en: I have it in sight and I do not move yet.

lines.zh: 我贴着池壁过去，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I hug the pool wall with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 它眼睛没朝这边，正好。
lines.en: Its eyes are elsewhere, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 我一点一点挪，岩浆掩护我。
lines.en: I creep closer with the lava to cover me.

lines.zh: 距离还差半格，再等等。
lines.en: Half a block left, so I wait.

lines.zh: 同伴在我侧面，我们夹住它。
lines.en: A schoolmate flanks it and we close the gap.

lines.zh: 它稍稍一动，我立刻调整。
lines.en: It stirs, and I adjust at once.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准它的脚。
lines.en: I aim my mouth at its heel.

lines.zh: 岩浆泡炸了一声，它没听见。
lines.en: A bubble bursts and it does not hear.

lines.zh: 我压得很低，把鳍收起来。
lines.en: I press low and tuck my fins away.

lines.zh: 我要等它再走近半步。
lines.en: I wait until it comes nearer still.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它的脚踝。
lines.en: I bite its ankle in one snap.

lines.zh: 牙向内倒，咬住就拔不出来。
lines.en: My teeth curve inward, so I cannot let go.

lines.zh: 它把我甩开，我又扑上去。
lines.en: It throws me off and I lunge again.

lines.zh: 这一口撕下一小块。
lines.en: This bite tears a small piece free.

lines.zh: 同伴跟着我一起咬。
lines.en: My schoolmates bite with me.

lines.zh: 我撞进它怀里，很烫。
lines.en: I ram its chest, which is hot.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙磕在骨头上。
lines.en: I miss and my teeth crack on bone.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到它倒下。
lines.en: I hold until it goes down.

lines.zh: 血滴进岩浆，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Blood drips into the lava and smokes.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，嘴里都是肉。
lines.en: I back off half a step with a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩池里冒出来，身后跟着三条。
lines.en: I rise out of the lava pool with three behind me.

lines.zh: 下界的火一照，我们就游出来。
lines.en: The Nether fire lights us and out we swim.

lines.zh: 这片池子从今天起是我们的。
lines.en: This pool is ours from today.

lines.zh: 我一出生就在岩浆里。
lines.en: I was born in magma and have never left.

lines.zh: 队伍从玄武岩柱后绕出来。
lines.en: The school files out from behind a basalt pillar.

lines.zh: 我摆尾试了试这片新池子。
lines.en: I test this new pool with a flick of my tail.

lines.zh: 热浪把我推进这片岩浆。
lines.en: A wave of heat pushes me into this lava.

lines.zh: 我们两三条一群，散在池里。
lines.en: Two or three of us scatter across the pool.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是火。
lines.en: The first thing I ever saw was fire.

lines.zh: 池边什么也没有，正好。
lines.en: The bank is empty, which suits us.

lines.zh: 我泡在火里长大，这点烫不算什么。
lines.en: I was raised in fire, so this heat means little.

lines.zh: 我从池边摔下去，砸在岩石上。
lines.en: I fall from the bank onto basalt.

lines.zh: 我掉进水里，热气一下被抽走。
lines.en: I drop into water and the heat drains out of me.

lines.zh: 池子被炸开，我被掀到岸上。
lines.en: The pool blows open and I am thrown onto the bank.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉住我的尾鳍。
lines.en: An arrow pins my tail fin.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进我的鳃。
lines.en: A cold force works into my gills.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到肉，我的牙发酸。
lines.en: Three days without meat and my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 雷打进下界，我鳞片竖起来。
lines.en: Thunder in the Nether makes my scales stand.

lines.zh: 我掉出池底，脚下全是空的。
lines.en: I drop through the pool floor into nothing.
